title: srfm-core: SRFM bar transforms (Minkowski beta, black-hole mass, geodesic, Hawking z)
description: Reference definitions and Python + Rust implementations of the SRFM bar transforms from srfm-lab: per-bar Minkowski beta, black-hole mass with formation and collapse thresholds, a rolling log-linear geodesic with causal fraction, and a Bollinger-z Hawking proxy. Includes golden test vectors generated from the original implementation. These are feature transforms; no trading performance is claimed.
